summary: Arequipa stands under Peru's national legal framework, and the national measures in force bind the department. The source inventory contains no Arequipa-specific trans law, ordinance, incident series, enforcement finding or institutional practice; all three sources reviewed are national in scope and their content is carried by the Peru record. The national assessment applies to the department without local modification.
tangentialFactors: No comparative or neighbouring-jurisdiction material specific to Arequipa appears in the inventory, and nothing in the sources distinguishes the department from the national position. Whether national rules are applied differently in Arequipa than elsewhere in Peru is not documented in the material reviewed.
localsOnly: No resident-facing facts specific to Arequipa were identified in the source inventory.
outOfScopeNotes: All three sources in the inventory are national in scope. None records an Arequipa-specific provision, incident or enforcement finding, so the department's position cannot be differentiated from the national one on the evidence available.
